purpose: 记录本任务使用的官方 upstream 资产与任务提示词的溯源与校验值，用于证明服务侧输入语义与官方 upstream 一致（官方评测集下发后可直接对拍）

inference_py_parity.note: 与 upstream HEAD 的 inference.py 逐字一致；唯一差异是本地快照用 CRLF 行尾、upstream 用 LF（diff --strip-trailing-cr 后无差异）

prompt_templates._source: upstream inference.py 第 50-58 行，逐字复制
prompt_templates.pointing: {text}. Please provide its 2D coordinates. Your answer should be formatted as a tuple, i.e. [(x, y)], where the tuple contains the x and y coordinates of a point satisfying the conditions above.
prompt_templates.trajectory: Please predict 3D end-effector-centric waypoints to complete the task successfully. The task is "{text}". Your answer should be formatted as a list of tuples, i.e., [(x1, y1, d1), (x2, y2, d2), ...], where each tuple contains the x and y coordinates and the depth of the point.
prompt_templates.grounding: Please provide the bounding box coordinate of the region this sentence describes: {text}.

parsing_regexes._source: upstream inference.py 第 110/116/122 行，逐字复制（scripts/answer_adapter.py 中 RE_TRAJ / RE_POINT / RE_BOX）

local_only_format_bridges._note: 仅做表面格式桥接，不改任何数值，不改模型/采样/权重；原文始终保留
local_only_format_bridges.RE_BBOX_TAG: <bbox>x1 y1 x2 y2</bbox>  ->  [x1, y1, x2, y2]
local_only_format_bridges.RE_BOX_SPECIAL: <|box_start|>[x1, y1, x2, y2]<|box_end|>  ->  [x1, y1, x2, y2]

known_gaps: upstream demo 脚本引用的 assets/demo/navigation1.jpg 与 assets/demo/navigation2.jpg 在 upstream 仓库中均不存在；本任务使用实际存在的 navigation.jpg 覆盖 Case 6，Case 7 无法从官方资产复现，如实标注为 NOT_REPRODUCIBLE，不自造图片。
upstream 官方解析正则只覆盖整数坐标（pointing/grounding）与带小数深度的 trajectory；科学计数法/负坐标等格式不被覆盖。官方评测若使用更宽的容差，需以官方判分器为准。
